title: Migrate SMT runtime to go-git

notes:
Manager decision 2026-08-01 after backend API audit: go-git v5.19.2 has no public submodule-add API, but .2 requires ordinary submodule gitlinks. Authorize a bounded pure-Go implementation only: bootstrap and commit each child with go-git; clone it to the component path through go-git; deterministically write .gitmodules for SMT's fixed, fresh scaffold components; insert/update the root index entry at that component path with mode 160000/filemode.Submodule and child HEAD hash through go-git storage; commit root with go-git. No generic submodule editor and no system-git fallback. Required interoperability proof: reopen root and assert .gitmodules content, tree/index gitlink mode/hash, and go-git discovery of declared submodule; also retain a compiled-runtime PATH-without-git proof. Worker initial audit: Context7/source confirmed push/auth primitives, no public add-submodule. No code changed in initial handoff.
Second manager decision 2026-08-01 from behavioral no-system-Git proof: go-git v5.19.2 PlainClone of SMT's local bootstrap path invokes git-upload-pack and fails when PATH lacks git, so PlainClone is rejected. Preserve the no-system-Git compiled-runtime invariant. Authorize only a bounded pure filesystem bootstrap checkout: recursively copy the freshly initialized/committed bootstrap worktree and its .git into the selected component path using Go filesystem APIs; reopen with go-git; set/verify origin metadata through go-git; then write .gitmodules and root 160000 gitlink. No generic clone implementation or system-git fallback. Required proof remains restricted-PATH init plus go-git inspection/push dry-run and submodule/tree gitlink validation.
Automation accepted by work_manager on 2026-08-01 in /private/tmp/smt-agentic-development. Migrated compiled runtime to github.com/go-git/go-git/v5 v5.19.2; removed system-git runner, checkout/worktree production and test paths, worktree CLI routing/usage, and doctor Git executable prerequisite. Implemented bounded pure-Go fresh bootstrap checkout because go-git local PlainClone starts git-upload-pack: copy fresh bootstrap including .git, configure child origin through go-git, write deterministic .gitmodules, and commit root mode-160000 gitlinks. Manager checks passed: GOCACHE=/private/tmp/smt-gocache go test ./internal/git ./internal/scaffold ./internal/operations ./cmd/smt -count=1; GOCACHE=/private/tmp/smt-gocache go test ./... -count=1; GOCACHE=/private/tmp/smt-gocache go vet ./...; git diff --check; static no system-git/runner/worktree scan.
